timedMC.title: Beat the clock
timedMC.subtitle: 15 seconds per question. Watch for missing 'been', have/has agreement, and the two traps: finished quantities and state verbs, which need the simple present perfect instead.

questions.text: My sister        the piano for three years.
wrongReasons: Subject-verb agreement: with 'my sister', use 'has', not 'have'.
Wrong tense: duration up to now with 'for' needs the present perfect, not the present continuous.
Missing 'been' — 'has been playing', not 'has playing'.
